exception.threat_model: The reviewed default-branch workflow checks out validators at github.workflow_sha and reads candidate files with a contents-read token and no persisted credentials. Candidate scripts and actions never execute; no App token, secrets, caches or write permission are used. Checkout's fork protection remains enabled. Feedback is not a required check, and full CI retains edited coverage. The organization-wide event policy remains disabled; activating it requires a reviewed scoped exclusion and the evidence in issue 202.
